cause: Q2'24 DAU growth accelerated to 59% YoY (vs guided deceleration), record 27% Adjusted EBITDA margin, 5th consecutive quarter of net income positivity, 8M paying subscribers, and FY24 guidance raised (bookings ~32.5%, revenue ~38.5%, EBITDA margin lifted to 24.5%, +7pp vs 2023)
quality: 经营性持续: this is the second consecutive strong quarter for Duolingo (following the Feb-24 print already judged true), with engagement actually re-accelerating rather than decelerating as previously guided, and margin expansion continuing on real operating leverage
reason: A second straight beat-and-raise with DAU growth actually accelerating (59% vs prior guide of deceleration) and record margins is a strong durable signal, not a sugar high. No FCF or capex red flags surfaced. Main watch item is a tough 2023 comp (Barbie movie brand tailwind) into H2, but management explicitly guided through that already (H2 DAU guided ~50% YoY, still very strong) and flagged no worrying consumer behavior shifts.
